local Opt = {
	PlayCamera = true,
	PlayMove = true,
	PlayKeys = true,
	PlayMouse = true,
	Speed = 1,
	Loop = false,
	LoopCount = 0,
	LoopDelay = 0.15,
}

local Playing = false
local PlayToken = 0

local function safe(fn, ...)
	local ok, a, b, c = pcall(fn, ...)
	if ok then return a, b, c end
	return nil
end

local function cam()
	return workspace.CurrentCamera
end

local function getRoot()
	local c = LocalPlayer.Character
	return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function getHum()
	local c = LocalPlayer.Character
	return c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

-- CLICK / INPUT METHODS (same as CracksMacro)
local function moveMouseTo(x, y)
	x = tonumber(x) or 0
	y = tonumber(y) or 0
	safe(function()
		VIM:SendMouseMoveEvent(x, y, game)
	end)
	safe(function()
		if mousemoveabs then
			mousemoveabs(x, y)
		end
	end)
	safe(function()
		if syn and syn.mousemoveabs then
			syn.mousemoveabs(x, y)
		end
	end)
end

local function mouseButton(x, y, btn, down)
	moveMouseTo(x, y)
	task.wait()
	safe(function()
		VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, btn or 0, down == true, game, 0)
	end)
	safe(function()
		if btn == 0 then
			if down and mouse1press then
				mouse1press()
			elseif not down and mouse1release then
				mouse1release()
			end
		elseif btn == 1 then
			if down and mouse2press then
				mouse2press()
			elseif not down and mouse2release then
				mouse2release()
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function tableToCf(t)
	if type(t) ~= "table" or #t < 12 then
		return nil
	end
	return CFrame.new(t[1], t[2], t[3], t[4], t[5], t[6], t[7], t[8], t[9], t[10], t[11], t[12])
end

local function keycodeFromName(name)
	return safe(function()
		return Enum.KeyCode[name]
	end)
end

local function playOnce(steps, token)
	local t0 = tick()
	local speed = math.clamp(tonumber(Opt.Speed) or 1, 0.1, 8)
	local camera = cam()
	local oldType = camera and camera.CameraType
	if Opt.PlayCamera and camera then
		safe(function()
			camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
		end)
	end
	for _, ev in ipairs(steps) do
		if not Playing or token ~= PlayToken then
			break
		end
		local target = t0 + ((tonumber(ev.t) or 0) / speed)
		while tick() < target and Playing and token == PlayToken do
			task.wait()
		end
		if not Playing or token ~= PlayToken then
			break
		end
		if ev.k == "cf" and Opt.PlayMove then
			local root = getRoot()
			if root and ev.x then
				safe(function()
					root.CFrame = CFrame.new(ev.x, ev.y, ev.z) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(ev.yaw or 0), 0)
				end)
			end
		elseif ev.k == "cam" and Opt.PlayCamera then
			local c = cam()
			local cf = tableToCf(ev.cf)
			if c and cf then
				safe(function()
					c.CFrame = cf
					if ev.fov then
						c.FieldOfView = ev.fov
					end
				end)
			end
		elseif ev.k == "key" and Opt.PlayKeys then
			local code = keycodeFromName(ev.code)
			if code then
				safe(function()
					VIM:SendKeyEvent(ev.down == true, code, false, game)
				end)
			end
			if ev.down and ev.code == "Space" then
				local hum = getHum()
				if hum then
					hum.Jump = true
				end
			end
		elseif ev.k == "mouse" and Opt.PlayMouse then
			if ev.move then
				moveMouseTo(ev.x, ev.y)
			end
			if ev.btn ~= nil and ev.down ~= nil then
				mouseButton(ev.x, ev.y, ev.btn, ev.down)
			end
			if ev.wheel then
				moveMouseTo(ev.x, ev.y)
				safe(function()
					VIM:SendMouseWheelEvent(ev.x, ev.y, ev.wheel > 0, game)
				end)
			end
		end
	end
	if Opt.PlayCamera and camera and oldType then
		safe(function()
			camera.CameraType = oldType
		end)
	end
end

local function loadMacroTable()
	local data = safe(function()
		return HttpService:JSONDecode(marcocode)
	end)
	if type(data) ~= "table" then
		warn("[MacroPlayer] invalid embedded JSON")
		return nil
	end
	-- support { "macro1": [ ... ] } or raw array
	if data[1] and data[1].k then
		return data
	end
	if data.macro1 then
		return data.macro1
	end
	for _, v in pairs(data) do
		if type(v) == "table" and v[1] and v[1].k then
			return v
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function playMacro()
	local steps = loadMacroTable()
	if type(steps) ~= "table" or #steps == 0 then
		warn("[MacroPlayer] empty macro")
		return
	end
	PlayToken += 1
	local token = PlayToken
	Playing = true
	print("[MacroPlayer] PLAY (" .. #steps .. " events)")
	task.spawn(function()
		local loops = 0
		repeat
			if not Playing or token ~= PlayToken then break end
			loops += 1
			playOnce(steps, token)
			if not Opt.Loop then break end
			if Opt.LoopCount > 0 and loops >= Opt.LoopCount then break end
			task.wait(Opt.LoopDelay)
		until not Playing or token ~= PlayToken
		Playing = false
		print("[MacroPlayer] done")
	end)
end

local function stopPlay()
	PlayToken += 1
	Playing = false
	print("[MacroPlayer] stopped")
end

-- auto-run once on execute
playMacro()

print("[MacroPlayer] loaded | P=play X=stop")
